📈 Amazon SKU Economics Report — All brands
Amazon Seller Central → Reports → Business Reports → SKU Economics. Covers all brands and regions in one file. Automatically detects format, maps ASINs, sums child variants, and captures COGS (USD).
⚠ One week per upload — Sunday through Saturday
In Seller Central's report download dialog, set Date range = exactly one Sunday → Saturday (e.g. 2025-09-07 → 2025-09-13). Multi-week or off-boundary uploads are rejected. This prevents an entire date range from being upserted into one inflated weekly row (which previously created spikes that had to be cleaned out via SQL).
📈
SKU Economics — All Brands
Seller Central → Reports → SKU Economics · single Sun→Sat week only
Columns: ASIN · Net units sold · Reporting Week · Region · COGS
🇪🇺 Amazon EU SKU Economics — GB / DE / FR / IT / ES / NL
Amazon Seller Central (EU account) → Reports → Business Reports → SKU Economics. Separate report from the US/CA file — different fee taxonomy (Digital Services Fees, Fuel surcharge) and native currencies (GBP / EUR). Lands in the dedicated sku_economics_eu table; viewable on the P&L tab via the 🇪🇺 EU region toggle.
⚠ One week per upload — Sunday through Saturday · EU rows only
The EU report's Amazon store column must contain only EU country codes (GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL). US/CA rows are rejected — use the standard SKU Economics uploader above for those. You'll be prompted for the brand to assign to any newly-discovered ASINs (no Brand column in the raw export).
🇪🇺
EU SKU Economics — All EU markets
Seller Central (EU) → Reports → SKU Economics · single Sun→Sat week only
Columns: Amazon store · Start/End date · ASIN · Currency code · Net units sold · Net proceeds total

📦 Chewy — Rolling Demand Forecast (Vendor Statement)
Chewy Vendor Portal → Forecasting → Vendor Statement. Each upload is a monthly rolling forecast snapshot — upload every time you receive a new file to track how Chewy's forecasts evolve over time.
Snapshot date (file received):
⚠ For backfilling older files: set this to the date Chewy originally sent the file (not today). Otherwise the older forecast will be tagged with today's date and will override your newer forecasts in the "latest snapshot" view. Past data isn't lost — but the displayed current forecast will revert. Leave blank only when uploading the most recent file you have.

Metric
Fee Breakdown
Per-ASIN breakdown of every sku_economics row matching the current filters (region/period/brand/category/search). Built to find Looker-vs-app discrepancies — unmatched ASINs hiding fees, suspect duplicates, off-Monday weeks, brand misattributions.
⚠ Unmatched ASINs
ASINs present in sku_economics but missing from products. They carry fees / ad spend that the Brand filter currently drops. Add them to the products catalog (or pick a brand to assign them to) so their costs roll up correctly.
📋 Matched ASINs (per-row)
Every ASIN being summed into the P&L Summary view, including the product brand we matched it to. Useful for spotting brand misattributions (an ASIN here under "Doggijuana" that Looker counts as something else, or vice versa).
📅 Week-start hygiene
Amazon SKU Economics rows where week_start isn't a Monday. Past versions (v4.91, v4.92) had timezone-poisoned parsers that produced shifted dates — leftover rows from those uploads would show up here. Should be empty in current data.
⚠ Possible duplicate weeks
ASINs that have ≥2 sku_economics rows for the same calendar week under different week_start values (typically off-by-a-day or off-by-a-week from a re-upload). Each such pair inflates the totals because both rows are summed.
Period → Brand Category Quick
⚠ Partial data — Shopify P&L currently pulls revenue + units from sales_weekly and COGS from product_cogs.dtc_cogs. Not yet included: transaction / payment-processor fees, shipping costs, refund admin, ad spend (Meta / Google). Net Proceeds here is "Net Sales − COGS" with no fee/cost subtraction yet; expect it to look better than reality until those uploads land.

Brand Show Status
CSV format — header row: master_id,amazon_cogs,amazon_cogs_eu,dtc_cogs,chewy_cogs. Upload upserts on master_id; empty cells leave the existing value untouched. Use Download CSV to grab a starting template pre-populated with current values. A product is flagged "Missing" only for channels it's actually sold on (Amazon if it has an ASIN, DTC if it has a Shopify SKU, Chewy if it has a Chewy SKU). The Amazon EU COGS column overrides Amazon COGS for the P&L EU view; leave blank to fall back to Amazon COGS.
